About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
What You’ll Do
  • Develop and maintain risk frameworks, assessments, risk appetite measures and controls for regulated digital asset businesses.
  • Oversee market surveillance, investigate potential market abuse and coordinate escalations and regulatory reporting with Compliance and Legal.
  • Improve surveillance systems, monitoring scenarios and alert thresholds, ensuring effective data coverage and investigation processes.
  • Lead risk and surveillance workstreams for VASP and equivalent licence applications, including regulatory documentation, regulator engagement and operational readiness.
  • Report key risks, surveillance findings and remediation progress to management and boards. Partner with internal teams to assess new products, business changes and jurisdictional expansion.
What You Bring
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in risk management, market surveillance or regulatory oversight within a digital asset business or regulated financial institution.
  • Hands-on experience investigating trading activity, with a strong understanding of market abuse, market microstructure and order books.
  • Experience developing risk frameworks, governance documentation and management reporting, and supporting licence applications or regulatory reviews.
  • Familiarity with digital asset products, exchange operations and regulatory expectations for licensed businesses.
  • Strong analytical, investigative and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
  • A degree in finance, economics, law, risk management or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with surveillance platforms such as Solidus Labs, Nasdaq SMARTS or Eventus.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python or other trading data analysis tools.
  • Experience supporting regulated entities or licensing projects across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Relevant professional qualifications, such as FRM or CFA.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Marketing Analytics helps Marketing understand their impact on Stripe and invest in the right opportunities by delivering trusted measurement, actionable guidance, and strategic partnership. It is situated within the broader Data Science organization at Stripe, which is home to a diverse team of analysts, data scientists, and engineers that span their focus across Stripe’s business and products.

What you’ll do

As Manager of the Marketing Analytics team, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of analysts that delivers rigorous analysis, strategic guidance, and trusted data products to Marketing leaders. You will set the team’s strategy in close partnership with Marketing, translating its most important questions and needs into scalable analytical solutions. As a holistic and solutions-oriented leader, you will continually strengthen how the team operates and help your analysts grow. Your team’s work will enable informed investment decisions across the customer journey, from lead generation and acquisition through engagement and retention.

Responsibilities 

  • Develop and drive a roadmap that equips business partners with the data, analyses, and insights needed to articulate Marketing’s impact on the business.
  • Act as a player-coach to manage and motivate a team of analysts, partnering with them to go deep in developing expertise in Stripe’s business and Marketing data.
  • Create a long-term strategy to improve the team’s data and measurement capabilities for use by people and artificial intelligence agents
  • Develop and lead processes and team norms that provide structure, elevate the quality of the team’s work, and enable Marketing Analytics to collaborate effectively across Stripe.
  • Act as a thought leader in areas of agentic automation, data analysis, manipulation, visualization, and storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of data analytics experience, including 3+ years directly managing Data Analytics or Marketing Analytics teams, and experience building a team, defining its mission, and executing on its goals
  • A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctoral Degree
  • Proven track record of cross-functional collaboration, with strong analytical skills to navigate complex decisions and navigate trade-offs
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines using a distributed data framework (e.g. Hadoop, Spark)
  • Experience building self-serve dashboards or other scalable analytical tools for partner teams
  • Strong knowledge of statistics
  • Expertise in data storytelling and visualization, using data-driven insights to deliver actionable recommendations and drive business goals

  • Experience partnering with Marketing or Sales teams to design and implement measurement frameworks that inform investment planning, channel attribution, and success metrics for new strategies.

  • Advanced degree in in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Sciences or a related quantitative field and/or experience in working on data analytics in the tech field

About us

Luno is the crypto investment app you can rely on, enabling you to buy, store and explore crypto securely. We’re committed to putting the power of cryptocurrency in everyone's hands, sensibly and responsibly. Since 2013, we’ve helped millions of people around the world invest safely in crypto. We do this by cutting through the hype and supporting customers at every step of the way. All products and cryptocurrencies on our platform must first meet stringent legal, risk and technical security standards.Transparency is key for us. Luno stores all crypto on a 1:1 basis and we have rigorous processes in place so you can be confident your investment is secure. We're available in multiple markets around the world and we work closely with regulators and other key stakeholders to ensure compliance with local laws, as we believe this is the best way to help everyone, everywhere, invest safely.

The role in a nutshell:

We’re looking for a commercially sharp Senior Manager, Payment Partnerships to join GTXN - a Luno company and own the sourcing, negotiation and delivery of new banking and payment-provider partnerships across Africa and Southeast Asia. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging and closing arrangements with the payment providers and banks that let GTXN move money for our customers reliably, quickly and at the right cost. This is a remote-first role, and you will report to Paul Harker.

You will bring hands-on experience building payment-provider and banking relationships in African markets, and be comfortable owning a deal from first conversation through contracting and go-live. Experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.



Your mission will be:

  • Identify, prioritise and build a pipeline of payment providers, banks and PSPs across African markets (and select Southeast Asian markets) that can extend GTXN’s ability to move money for Luno’s customers.
  • Own end-to-end deal execution: outreach, commercial negotiation, contracting and onboarding of new banking and payment-provider partners.
  • Manage and grow a portfolio of existing partner relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for commercial, operational and performance matters.
  • Negotiate commercial terms — pricing, settlement, liability, SLAs — that improve the cost, coverage and reliability of GTXN’s payment rails.
  • Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to ensure new partnerships meet regulatory, licensing and integration requirements before go-live.
  • Monitor partner performance against agreed SLAs (uptime, settlement times, success rates) and drive remediation where partners underperform.
  • Track regulatory, competitive and market developments across target emerging markets that could affect partner selection or deal terms.
  • Represent GTXN with key partners and at industry events, building GTXN’s reputation as a partner of choice in target markets.
  • Feed market intelligence into GTXN’s regional expansion strategy, helping prioritise markets and partners with the strongest commercial and strategic fit.

A little about you:

  • 5-8+ years of experience in payment partnerships, business development or commercial roles at a payment service provider, bank, remittance company or fintech, with a track record of sourcing and closing deals with banks and payment providers.
  • Demonstrable experience engaging with payment providers and banks across African markets; experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.
  • Deep understanding of cross-border payment flows and the commercial and technical mechanics of PSP and banking partnerships (settlement, FX, licensing, compliance).
  • Proven ability to independently source, negotiate and close commercial agreements, from first contact through contract execution and onboarding.
  • Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, able to structure deals that balance cost, risk and speed to market.
  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a remote-first, distributed team, across multiple time zones and jurisdictions.
  • Excellent relationship-management and stakeholder-management skills, able to work cross-functionally with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product and Engineering.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages relevant to target African (or Southeast Asian) markets are advantageous.
  • An existing network of relationships with payment providers and banks in target African markets is a strong advantage.
  • Willingness to travel as required to meet partners and represent GTXN in-market.
  • Working knowledge of, and genuine interest in, crypto and digital assets is advantageous, given GTXN's role within the broader Luno business.

 

First 6 Months:

  • Build a prioritised pipeline of target payment-provider and banking partners across GTXN’s core African markets.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of GTXN’s existing partner network, product and commercial model.
  • Close and onboard the first new partner agreement(s) in a priority market.
  • Establish effective working relationships with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to streamline partner onboarding.
  • Build credibility as a trusted point of contact for both new and existing partners.

 

Life at Luno:

  • Remote but reachable work policy gives you the freedom to choose between working from home or the office.
  • Plus the option to buy and sell up to 5 days leave
  • Improve body and mind, with excellent private medical insurance
  • Retirement fund benefit helping you build the financial foundation you need to enjoy your future to the fullest.
  • Access to Learnably and our additional learning platforms for your personal and professional development
  • 6 months primary care-giver leave
  • Paw-ternity leave for your furry friend
  • Annual Inspiration Day in addition to your annual leave which increases based on your length of service! 
  • A collaborative, friendly work community, with regular social events and virtual cooking, dancing, drawing and house planting classes hosted by our Lunauts
  • Free lunch and snacks
  • 0 fees up to a certain amount with Luno from the day you start.*

*Offer only available on Luno Instant Buy, not Luno Exchange.

Vice President of Finance

Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

As a Senior Engineering Manager on Circle's Risk and Compliance Engineering team, you will lead the engineering team responsible for building and scaling our centralized customer onboarding and lifecycle management platform, a foundational component of Circle's risk management and regulatory compliance infrastructure. Your team will develop capabilities supporting the entire customer journey, from initial engagement and onboarding through ongoing customer relationship changes, additional product adoption, and product-specific onboarding requirements. Onboarding serves as a critical first line of risk control, establishing the customer identity, eligibility, risk assessments, and compliance safeguards that shape Circle's operating environment and support downstream fraud prevention, ongoing risk management, and regulatory compliance. You will drive the development of scalable automation, partner-facing SDKs, and internal compliance tools that enable seamless, secure customer experiences across Circle's products and jurisdictions. Working closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Engineering stakeholders, you will guide technical architecture, engineering execution, and operational excellence while developing a high-performing, inclusive engineering team.


What you'll work on

  • Lead and develop the engineering team responsible for Circle's centralized customer onboarding and lifecycle management platform, establishing foundational risk and compliance capabilities.
  • Build scalable business and consumer onboarding automation that supports customers from initial engagement through activation across Circle's products.
  • Design and evolve a unified customer lifecycle platform that manages changes in customer relationships, product combinations, and onboarding requirements over time.
  • Guide the development of partner-facing SDKs, APIs, and integrations that enable seamless onboarding and product activation experiences within third-party applications.
  • Build extensible product-specific onboarding capabilities that support customer eligibility, additional verification, and jurisdiction-specific compliance requirements as customers adopt new Circle products.
  • Develop internal tools and partner with Product, Risk, Compliance, Fraud, and Engineering teams to support customer reviews, lifecycle changes, and downstream risk management.
  • Drive architectural decisions, engineering reliability, security, and operational excellence while coaching senior and staff-level engineers and developing a high-performing, inclusive engineering team.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including 3+ years of people management experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong technical background designing scalable distributed systems, APIs, and complex backend platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical guidance, coach, and mentor senior and staff-level engineers while supporting their professional growth.
  • Experience making architectural decisions and delivering secure, reliable systems with high standards for engineering and operational excellence.
  • Strong people leadership, execution, and cross-functional collaboration skills, including hiring, performance management, and delivery ownership.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience building customer onboarding, identity verification, KYC/KYB, or regulatory compliance platforms.
  • Experience developing partner-facing APIs, embeddable SDKs, or workflow automation for consumer and business applications.
  • Familiarity with financial services, fintech, payments, or jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements.

Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.

Own Your Intelligence

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

Prime's research compounds when other researchers can run it, inspect it, extend it, and build on it. You will own the path from emerging research artifact to excellent open-source and product experience. This role sits inside Applied Research and works deeply with engineering. You will build core open-source systems, shape researcher-facing features in our training platform, decide which abstractions deserve stable interfaces, and help external contributors ship serious work into the stack.

Responsibilities

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Role scope

You will work continuously with external researchers and contributors. Prime's public surface already includes verifiers v1, prime-rl's extensible algorithms layer, and more than 2,500 community environments. The opportunity is to make the full path from task and harness through evaluation, training, and deployment feel like one coherent research system.

Representative early problems

  • Make a new researcher successful from environment idea to credible evaluation and training run without hiding the underlying experimental choices.

  • Turn fast-moving internal agent and RL abstractions into stable public interfaces without freezing weak ideas prematurely.

  • Create a contributor path where external researchers can ship environments, harnesses, algorithms, and integrations that meet a serious technical bar.

What you will own

  • Important open-source RL, environment, evaluation, and agent systems.

  • Researcher-facing features in our training platform, built with engineering and design.

  • APIs, examples, reference implementations, and technical explanations that expose useful abstractions.

  • Work with research users and external contributors that leads to better interfaces, inspectable code, and research artifacts.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: ownership of open-source ML or developer-tool systems, research engineering, technical product work, or communities formed around code and reproducible research.

  • Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

  • Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

  • Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

Benefits and Perks

  • Cash Compensation Range of $150-300k + equity incentives

  • Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

  • Visa Sponsorship & relocation support

  • Professional Development budget

  • Team Off-sites & conference attendance

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.
